description: This file manages WhatsApp login via QR code, including generating QR codes, handling login state, socket management, and session renewal.

classes.name: ActiveLogin
classes.description: Represents an active WhatsApp login session, including socket, status, and QR code data.

methods.name: closeSocket
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection for a given socket.

methods.name: resetActiveLogin
methods.description: Resets the login session for a given account, closing socket and clearing login data.

methods.name: isLoginFresh
methods.description: Checks if the login session is still within its valid TTL.

methods.name: attachLoginWaiter
methods.description: Attaches a promise to wait for WebSocket connection and updates login status.

methods.name: restartLoginSocket
methods.description: Attempts to restart the WebSocket connection for a login session.

methods.name: startWebLoginWithQr
methods.description: Initiates a WhatsApp login process, generating a QR code for authentication.

methods.name: waitForWebLogin
methods.description: Waits for a WhatsApp login to complete or timeout, handling errors and session status.
